[N.b.: This posting is for the Rocq version of SF and really belongs on the Rocq Zulip -- it appears here mostly because I don't know how to delete it. :-) The Lean translation of the first two volumes is also underway.]

Just in time for the new school year... the Software Foundations team is proud to announce a new release of all volumes in the series.  Improvements include...

  • Significant polishing of the recently added (Jan 2026) volume on Security Foundations, by Cătălin Hriţcu and Yonghyun Kim.
  • A new chapter of Logical Foundations presenting a formal development of the Curry-Howard correspondence, by Michael Clarkson.
  • An extensive rewrite of the Normalization chapter of Logical Foundations by Andrew Tolmach, developing the proof through a series of increasingly sophisticated failed attempts, with many new exercises.
  • The monolithic pumping-lemma exercise in the Inductively Defined Propositions chapter of Logical Foundations has been broken into a graded series of smaller problems.

Plus polishing, new exercises, etc., throughout. All volumes are compatible with the current version of Rocq.

Share and enjoy!

Benjamin   
and the SF development team
